messages:
Maria: quick check — Glasgow region onboarding. Are we green on egress peering + KMS key readiness? Need final owners for legal signoff before cutover. cc @Alex @Tina
Alex: infra: peering config is applied in staging but BGP session hasn't flapped to ESTABLISHED yet. PR with configs is up.
Tina: legal: we need the residency attestation filled out (template). who will own that doc?
Sam: network: ASN is `64512`, pushed to PR. also confirmed route filters are applied to the peer.
Maria: thanks. who will own the final smoke runbook and checklist?
Alex: I'll do smoke runs, but need an ops buddy for the runbook steps — @Jonathan can pair?
Jonathan: can pair for smoke at 10:00am PT Wed. fine with runbook review earlier.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: `glasgow-proxy-staging` -> canary at 2024-11-06T10:00:00Z (auto-notify ops channel).
Tina: legal: sending the attestation template to the thread and DM. also need confirmation of encryption-in-transit (TLS versions) from infra. @Sam?
Sam: confirming: LB terminates TLS1.3, backend mTLS enabled for intra-region. will paste minimal tls config in PR.
Maria: blockers right now: 1) KMS key policy review 2) Legal attestation 3) BGP session stabilization 4) ACL exceptions signed off. Security/help?
Security: KMS policy review in progress, ETA end of day Tue. noted ACL request with approvers.
Alex: PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/glasgow/PR-4212 — config and notes in description.
DevEx: I'll update the Console region page and step-by-step screenshots once smoke runbook is final. ping me for exact copy.
Maria: action items recap: - Security: finish KMS policy review (Security) - Legal: finalize attestation (Tina) - Network: confirm BGP ESTABLISHED and ACLs (Sam/Alex) - Smoke: Alex + Jonathan to run at 10am PT Wed - Docs: DevEx to update Console & cutover checklist.
Alex: noted. will add checklist entries to the PR and tag approvers.
Tina: once attestation is in place, legal can clear cutover. please ping me when doc uploaded.
Maria: awesome — aiming for canary window Thu morning if all green. please update this thread when items land :thumbsup:
